title: Desk D-S0 entry generation: the judging run (50-packet pilot, then the registered schedule in batches of 200) that produces judged-1/{mask-key.json,proposals.jsonl} for units RQ-20261026-e535-03/-04
note: Filed 2026-10-26 by lane DESK-18-GEN-REPLAY-S0 (session_014Wuw5ZTBbMDhhYNnn9wGJx). WHAT: the only step between the pre-registered entry-generation units and a result. Units RQ-20261026-e535-01 (harness self-check) and -02 (random-entry null, strategy-own comparator, MEASURED sd and the n it implies) are token-free and dispatchable; -03 (arm 1) and -04 (novelty = new subset) score a JUDGED file that does not exist yet. Driver: scripts/research/desk_gen_replay_driver.py (modes selfcheck, baselines, packets, intake, score). BLOCKED ON: the held units PR landing, and RQ-20261026-e535-01 landing with verdict pass (do not spend judging tokens on an uncertified instrument). PROCEDURE (all of it: a lane runs it, it is a manager dispatch with a ceiling). (1) PILOT, nothing scored: python3 scripts/research/desk_gen_replay_driver.py packets --out <scratch> --fetch --seed 20261027 --n 50 (a SEPARATE seed, so no registered cutoff is touched); give each of 50 repo-less Sonnet sessions ONE packet from packets.jsonl plus <scratch>/JUDGE-PROTOCOL.md and nothing else; collect one JSON row each; run the intake mode on the rows; read cost per packet from get_session().usage deltas. NEVER run score on pilot output. The pilot answers two UNMEASURED things: proposals per packet (units -03/-04 declare 0.25 as an assumption) and dollars per packet. Ceiling $3. (2) Re-declare the power blocks of -03/-04 from the measured rate (a power edit; the decision_rule is not touched) in the promotion PR. (3) FULL RUN: packets with the registered seed in batches of 200 (--offset 0, 200, ...), the same judging, intake after every batch; stop when next_batch_allowed is false (800 valid proposals counted before any replay, or 1,500 packets). Commit comms/research/desk_gen_replay/judged-1/mask-key.json and proposals.jsonl only. The judge must not read the repo (the key goes public once committed). (4) The manager promotes -03 and -04 (git mv out of blocked/, remove blocked_on). COST PER DECISION POINT (one masked packet, one call): packet 16,912 characters median over 40 packets MEASURED 2026-10-26 (about 4.8 k tokens at 3.5 characters per token, INFERRED) + protocol 2,397 characters (about 0.7 k) + about 0.4 k output (assumed). Dollars UNMEASURED: floor about $0.001 (blended Sonnet $0.17 per million tokens from design 7 x 5.9 k tokens, which ignores the uncached-input price); ceiling $0.021 to $0.041 (design 5.3, a Sonnet call or working wake at a 122 k standing context, +-2x, which a stateless call is far below). 1,500 packets: about $1.5 to $62. The pilot replaces this bracket with a number. DONE WHEN: judged-1 is on main and -03/-04 have landed results. landed_unproven is NOT done. 2026-10-26 DESK-18B PILOT (lane, seed 20261027, 50 packets, scored NOTHING). INTAKE (driver intake mode, MEASURED): packets_judged 50, is_schedule_prefix true, rows 51 = 42 no_trade + 9 propose_entry, refused 0, over_cap 0, duplicate_symbol 0, valid_proposals_total 9, next_batch_allowed true. PROPOSALS/PACKET = 9/50 = 0.18 (exact Poisson 95% CI 4.1..17.1 events = 0.082..0.342; assumed 0.25 is inside it, so the pilot cannot tell 0.18 from 0.25). At 0.18 the 800-valid-proposal stop is never reached inside 1,500 packets (expected 270). COST via sessions (manager, MEASURED get_session usage.cost_usd): 5 sessions x 10 packets = $16.84 total = $0.337/packet. THE $3 PILOT CAP WAS BREACHED 5.6x (route: subagents inside a ~290k-token session context per batch; it is an upper bound on a stateless call, not a price of judging). Projection by this route: 1,500 x $0.337 = ~$505 - NOT VIABLE. p35 had one dropped digit in an sd_r value of its prompt (ASSET_06 short h4); its row is in the 50, flag it, exclude it from nothing registered (pilot only). STATELESS ROUTE BUILT, NOT RUN ($0 spent): scripts/research/desk_judge_api.py + tests/test_desk_judge_api.py (6 pass, fake client): one Messages API call per packet, protocol as system, packet as user, hard --max-usd, per-call usage ledger, resumable. ESTIMATE (INFERRED: tokens from characters at 3.5/token, Sonnet-tier list $3 in / $15 out per MTok from src/runtime/insights/usage.py, NOT verified for claude-sonnet-5-5): in ~5.55k tokens (packet 16,918 chars + protocol 2,397 + wrapper); out ~75 tokens mean (82% one-line no_trade) to 400 at the ceiling => $0.018-$0.023/packet => 1,500 packets ~$27-$34. The 2.4k-char protocol is below the 1,024-token cache minimum so prompt caching likely saves nothing; priced uncached. Worst-case guard (all input as cache write + 700 out) is higher and is only the cap check. RE-DECLARED POWER (PROPOSAL, power block only, decision_rule untouched; not applied to the blocked units - the manager applies it at promotion): -03 expected_n 375 -> 270 (1,500 x 0.18), min_detectable_effect 0.21 -> 0.24 (2.8 x 1.4/sqrt(270) = 0.239); -04 expected_n 320 -> 230 (270 x 0.85, the 0.85 novelty share still UNMEASURED), MDE 0.22 -> 0.26 (0.259). Both below the +0.10 R target by a wide margin and both inside the CI of the rate; at the CI ends n is 123..513 (MDE 0.35..0.17). RUN PATH (operator decides the API spend): the key exists ONLY on the live VM (.env ANTHROPIC_API_KEY); needs a system-action, name proposed: run-desk-judge (Tier 2: spends API money; wraps scripts/ops/run_desk_judge.sh which sources .env and calls desk_judge_api.py with --max-usd; NOT added by this lane). Packets for the registered seed are re-derived by the driver off-VM and committed to a keyless branch for the VM to fetch; the mask key never leaves the committing side.
